phase4.title: Training Zone lesson player — reformat onto the v3 card system
phase4.note: The player was recolored to CHCG brand but never adopted the v3 card language. This is a REFORMAT, not a recolor: bespoke layout primitives (cream/gradient banner, gold-gradient panels, custom stage pills, flat rails) are replaced by the same components Mission Hub uses. The design system has no repo write access — this entry is the executable spec for Claude Code.

visualReference.note: Commit the .dc.html as the visual reference. It opens directly in a browser and shows both modes side by side. $preview is 1440x2400 — the three-column composition needs >=1024px.

notes: variant='section' + tone='dark' already produces the Mission Hub header (uppercase title + gold underline). Do not hand-roll it.
KPI tile = variant='card' (default) + tone='dark' + eyebrow (gold micro-label) + title (the value) + titleStyle.

componentMap.usage: Progress rail rows (Next / Time left / Score) and the Reward row, all inside navy WidgetCards.
notes: Shipped InfoTile is icon-left/value-right and LIGHT-ONLY; on a navy card it renders white-on-white. This is why the rail was previously hand-rolled.
Shipped tint enum is cyan | gold | emerald | navy; the mock's softGold/softGreen map to gold/emerald.
Shipped icon badge is a rounded-xl SQUARE; the mock and the goal mock-ups use a CIRCLE — unresolved, see DESIGN_QA.md.

componentMap.usage: Enlarge, Previous, Next page, Submit answer, Continue.
notes: variant='gold' = gold fill + navy text; 'secondary'/'ghost' take onDark on navy surfaces.
Using the component is what gives these the gold focus ring — hand-rolled <button> falls back to the UA default, which is low-contrast on a gold pill.

componentMap.usage: Every var(--*) reference in the template and components.
notes: The app tokenizes only --accent-gold, --accent-gold-ink, --brand-navy, --brand-blue, --font-sans. Type scale, spacing, elevation, and --status-* are NOT tokenized — see TOKENS_DELTA.md §2.2/§2.3.
The template uses 44 distinct var(--*) refs. Port the tokens first or the reformat lands as inline literals again.

propDeltas.apply: Spread LAST onto the title element's style object, after the variant/tone-derived values, so callers can override them.
propDeltas.why: Routing a KPI value through the `title` slot inherits card-title typography (17px/600). At that size the number reads as an ordinary heading and loses the at-a-glance hierarchy that is the entire point of the Mission Hub KPI row.
propDeltas.example: 7 of 18 pages
propDeltas.callSites: 8 KPI tiles (4 per mode): Course progress 42% / Time left 12 min / Score 92% / Streak 8 days

propDeltas.default: false (no-op — existing light call sites are unaffected)
propDeltas.why: InfoTile is light-only. Inside a navy WidgetCard it renders a white card with navy text — the exact defect that forced the progress rail to be hand-rolled. A root `style` override cannot fix it because the text colors are internal to the component.

styleBehavior.label: onDark ? '#fff' : '#1B303C'
styleBehavior.cardSurface: when layout='card': background onDark ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : '#fff' · border onDark ? '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12)' : '1px solid rgba(27,48,60,0.10)' · boxShadow onDark ? 'none' : the light xs shadow
styleBehavior.iconBadge: UNCHANGED — the tint enum already reads correctly on navy (gold/emerald tints keep their contrast)

propDeltas.example: <InfoTile onDark layout="card" tint="gold" icon={<Clock/>} value="12 min" label="Time left" sub="This stage" />
propDeltas.callSites: 8 rows (4 per mode): Next / Time left / Score in the progress card, plus the Reward row
propDeltas.benefit: Applies to every dark surface in the app, not just this player — the same gap will appear anywhere InfoTile sits on navy.

behaviorDeltas.name: Checkpoint gating
behaviorDeltas.summary: The Checkpoint is no longer statically available. It is gated behind reaching the deck's final slide — visibly locked, never hidden.
behaviorDeltas.trigger: page >= LAST_PAGE (the deck's last visual). No extra button.
lockedState: Page tab: opacity .55, Lock glyph, neutral 'Locked' chip replacing the gold 'Quiz' chip, cursor:not-allowed, aria-disabled='true', aria-describedby pointing at the reason line.
Reason line beneath the tab: 'Complete the lesson to unlock.'

Canvas card: a full navy WidgetCard (NOT removed) containing a dashed lock panel — 'Complete the lesson to unlock' + a live remaining-page count — and the quiz beneath it ghosted at 34% opacity as skeleton bars, aria-hidden.
Rationale: an empty card reads as broken; showing the shape of what is coming is what makes it read as intentionally-not-yet.
behaviorDeltas.unlockedState: Page tab flips to a gold-tinted row with a gold glyph and the gold 'Quiz' chip; the card returns to the live role='radiogroup' quiz.
behaviorDeltas.transition: A one-shot 2.2s gold ring via @keyframes tp-unlock on a wrapper div, with a prefers-reduced-motion guard. Implemented as a keyframe rather than state-driven inline style so the card's own styling stays literal and paints immediately.
behaviorDeltas.a11y: The unlock is a silent visual change otherwise — pair it with a polite live region (role='status' aria-live='polite') emitting 'Checkpoint unlocked'. Fire it ONLY on the auto transition, not when a state is pinned for review.

behaviorDeltas.name: Responsive
behaviorDeltas.summary: Three columns at >=1024px; regions stack below; the deck slide goes single-column at <640px.
behaviorDeltas.shipped: In the app the stage/page rail moves into MobileNavDrawer and the progress rail becomes a stat strip, per RESPONSIVE_SPEC.md. The mock stacks instead, which is the simpler equivalent for a static reference.

behaviorDeltas.name: Dark mode figure/ground
behaviorDeltas.summary: The card component NEVER changes between modes — only the ground does. Light = navy WidgetCards above a white shell. Focus = the same navy cards below a lifted #1B3547→#152B3A shell. This is what keeps the dark surface reading as navy rather than near-black.
behaviorDeltas.goldRule: Gold is #FCBC34 on every navy surface in BOTH modes. #7A5200 appears only on the light deck slide, which is source material and never inverts.

behaviorDeltas.name: Deck slide stays light
behaviorDeltas.summary: The slide itself is #fff in both modes — it is source material. Only the surrounding chrome switches. An all-dark player dims the one thing the learner is there to read.

stillTemplateMarkup.why: No component exports a bare nav row — SidebarNav is the whole app rail with logo and profile. These also need aria-current plus the trailing check.
stillTemplateMarkup.contract: They use the accessible active state verbatim: gold fill, navy ink, 4px left marker, trailing Check glyph, >=44px, aria-current='page'.
stillTemplateMarkup.option: If engineering would rather port one component than markup, extract a NavRow — say so and the design system will add it.

portOrder: 1. Tokens first (TOKENS_DELTA.md §2.2/§2.3) — otherwise the reformat lands as inline literals again, which is the exact outcome this task exists to prevent.

5. Shell + header + KPI row, then the rail, then the canvas, then the progress rail.
6. Checkpoint gating (behaviorDeltas[0]), then the responsive rules.
